title: Fast-Track Bonus on Earned Pals Rewards Tiers: Questions Answered
content:
**Q. What is the fast-track bonus?**
A bonus added when an earned free tier of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** is applied, according to the calendar days from the date the currently held tier took effect to the date of the latest points-earning entry on the ledger.

**Q. What are the bands?**

| Days from the held tier's effective date to the latest points-earning entry | Fast-track bonus |
|---|---|
| at most 180 | 200 points |
| more than 180, at most 270 | 100 points |
| more than 270 | none |

**Q. Which dates are read?**
The tier effective date on the membership record — the date the tier the membership holds now took effect — and the date of the most recent points-earning entry on the rewards ledger. Bonus entries are not points-earning entries.

**Q. Worked dates (hypothetical)?**
Tier took effect 1 February; latest earning dated 31 July: 180 days, 200 points. Latest earning dated 1 August: 181 days, 100 points. Latest earning 270 days after the effective date: 100 points; 271 days: none.
